g.text: Entry points
Core
State
External
aur-chat script · python -m aur_chat · desktop entry
gui.py · QApplication tray host, one instance via QLockFile, injects XDG and DBus env
Main.qml · roster, filter, settings, tabs, dual-window toggle
ChatWindow.qml · second window in dual mode, closing it restores one window
ChatPane.qml · bubble list, composer, BBCode and emoticon rendering
backend.py 2100 lines · QObject bridge the whole UI talks to
friends poll timer · carries dropped persona fields forward, retries an empty roster
chat_stream.py · one long-lived aurelia chat events QProcess, JSON line per event
aurelia.py · subprocess wrapper, every call is aurelia subcommand plus --json
chat_format.py · outgoing escape and /code /pre /quote /spoiler, incoming BBCode to HTML
steam_shortcuts.py + launch_options.py · read shortcuts.vdf and localconfig.vdf
notify.py · notify-send plus canberra or pw-play message sound
~/.config/aur-chat/state.json · open tabs, window mode, hide offline, font sizes
~/.cache/aur-chat/emoticons · CDN images cached after first fetch
~/.cache/aur-chat/friends-debug.log · sync timeline, capped at 1 MiB
~/.config/Aurelia/session.json · Steam session owned by the daemon, GUI never reads it
aurelia daemon · friends, chat history, send, send-image, events stream
Steam network via the daemon · roster, persona, presence, rich presence
Steam community CDN · emoticon and sticker images
freedesktop notifications and system sound player
game launch · steam -applaunch, or aurelia play when a launch script exists
